app.name: Escrowd
app.footer: Escrowd — deposit starts work. Balance unlocks the file.

home.title: A deposit starts the drawing. The balance unlocks the file.
home.subtitle: Nour puts one link in her Instagram bio. The client fills a brief, pays a deposit, and gets a page they can return to. No deposit, no work. No final payment, no file.
home.step1Body: Fill what to draw. Pay the deposit on Paymob. Nour does not start until that payment is confirmed.
home.step2Body: You get a secret link — status and preview live there, not in DMs.
home.step3Body: The finished file appears only after the balance. Until then it stays in the studio.
home.workNote: The pictures lead. The chrome stays quiet.
home.closeBody: One form. A live price. Deposit starts work; the balance unlocks the file.

commission.title: Tell Nour what to draw.
commission.subtitle: The live price is display only. The server recomputes it, freezes the brief, then sends you to Paymob hosted checkout.

commission.phoneHint: Egyptian mobile. Paymob uses this on checkout.
commission.subjectsHint: People or characters in the drawing — 1 to 8.
commission.priceNote: Display only. The server recomputes and freezes this before Paymob.
commission.commercialNote: Commercial usage multiplies the price ×3. That is what the brief freezes.
commission.submit: Lock the brief and pay the deposit
